title: fix(metadata, objectql): two packages' same-named api items are both kept and served, and a qualified read gets its own package's body (ADR-0150 D3/D5)
body:
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9F9aEMgUDSdrmAN2hnjdDM5)_ Fixes #32069 Clause-②: no (narrowing) Metadata-protocol: none Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` and `content/docs/**` teach no `/meta/api` read at a package or `_env` that does not hold the item, and no answer for an api name two packages hold. Claim by `domain:server#3` (6760518917), seat ruling A (Claim amendment 6760739212). Reader child for #31700 under epic #31527 (ADR-0150). ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：元数据服务的 `api` 内存仓从按名一格改为按「包 + 名」分槽（新文件 `package-slotted-store.ts`，规则只写一处）；`api` 加进 `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`，于是 G1 的精确限定读与 D3 的无包裸读对 api 生效。 - 为什么改：两个包声明同名 api 时，后注册的覆盖先注册的。先注册那包的端点 404，`/meta/api/<它的命名空间>/<名>` 或 `?package=` 回 200 却是另一包的正文，盖着请求包的 `_packageId`。 - 风险与回滚：一个包持有某名时，裸读与持有者限定读逐字节不变。三处 200 改为 409（见下方 BREAKING），第一方受影响 0 处。同命名空间共有者同名同路径时，端点赢家从后注册者变为先注册者（matcher 不动）。回滚即 revert。 - 先看：`packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts`，然后 `metadata-manager.ts` 里调用它的各个接缝。 - 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts`，预期 32 条全过。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地。 ## What changes - **`packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts` (new)**: the slot rules for a by-package store type, written once. `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES = {'api'}`. - **Write** (`storeWriteKey`): an item carrying its package (stored envelope `packageId`, else the registry's `_packageId` stamp; `storedItemPackageId`, moved here from the manager's `indexedItemPackageId`) fills that package's slot. A package-less item under a name exactly one package holds fills that holder's slot (D4: a customization, never a second item); otherwise it fills the bare slot (the environment's own item). A package's first item under a name replaces the bare slot, as the bare-name map did. With one holder per name the store holds exactly the item it held before. - **Read** (`readStoreEntry`): a read naming a package answers that package's slot and never another package's item (a package holding no slot answers nothing, and the loaders are not asked for a by-name copy in its place). A read naming no package is D3 for a caller with no package (core `resolvePackageScopedHolders`): the environment's item, else the unique holder, else `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` (409) naming every holder. - Every other type keeps its bare-name key and behaves as before. - **`packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts`**: `register`, `registerInMemory` and the rollback write through `storeWriteKey`. `get` and `getDiagnosed` take the `packageId` the `/meta` protocol already passed (it was dropped). `list`, `listNames`, `exists`, `listForIndex`, `listForPackageScopedIndex`, `collectPackageMembers`, `admitLoaderItems` and `invalidateForForeignWrite` decode the name from the slot key. `unregisterPackage` removes only its own slot (it removed the bare name, which with two holders took the other package's item too). - **`packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-read.ts`**: `api` joins `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` (card comment 6760466682). G1's exact qualifier (D5) and E8's no-package bare read (D3) now apply to `api`. - **Endpoint matching is not changed** (METHOD + path, bucket 1). It now sees every package's endpoint, so: - Two namespaces' same-named apis each serve their own path. On main the first one's path answered `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`. - **Endpoint winner change, same-namespace co-owners**: when two packages of one namespace declare the same api name on the same path, main served the one registered last (it overwrote the first in the store). Head keeps both, and the matcher's existing duplicate-claim rule (equal names keep the first seen, with an `error` log line) serves the one registered first. This shape boots only from a cold start, since install-local already refuses a co-owner's same name. Per the seat ruling the matcher stays as it is. ### BREAKING (three `/meta/api` answers, first-party count 0) None of the four example apps addresses an api at a package that does not hold it, and none has an api name held by two packages. 1. `GET /meta/api/?package=X` and `GET /meta/api//`, for an api X does not hold: FROM `200` with the holder's item TO `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`not-held-by-qualifier`) naming the holder. The fix: address `?package=` or `/meta/api//`. 2. `GET /meta/api/_env/`, for an api a package holds and the environment does not: FROM `200` with the package's item TO `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming the holder. The fix: `/meta/api//`. 3. `GET /meta/api/` of a name two packages hold: FROM `200` with one of them TO `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`ambiguous-in-environment`) naming both. The metadata service's own `get('api', name)` with no package refuses the same way. The fix: `?package=` or `/meta/api//`. Items 1 and 2 are the same narrowing G1 (#31959) made for E8's nine types. The changeset carries the same FROM → TO and `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, since no stored shape changes. ## Why The `/meta` item read stitched two sources. The body came from the metadata service's in-memory store, keyed by bare name, so the package registered last overwrote the other, and `get()` ignored the package the protocol passed. The `_packageId` stamp came from objectql's per-package composite slot. A qualified read therefore got package B's body under package A's stamp. `api` was outside `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`, so G1's exact qualifier never checked it. Base readings on main ff04ad81, two packages `alpha` and `beta` each holding `qa_shared_api`: | Door | main | head | |:--|:--|:--| | `GET /meta/api/qa_shared_api` | 200, beta | 409 naming both | | `/meta/api/alpha/…`, `?package=…alpha` | 200, **beta's body stamped alpha** | 200, alpha's body and stamp | | `/meta/api/gamma/…` (non-holder) | 200, beta's body stamped alpha | 409 `not-held-by-qualifier` | | `GET /meta/api` list | beta only | both | | `/api/v1/apps/alpha/feed` | 404 | 200, alpha's | ## Tests - **`packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts`**: a new describe, "the in-memory api store keeps one slot per (package, name)". It covers: - Both endpoints are served. - `get` and `getDiagnosed` by package answer each holder's item, and a non-holder gets `undefined`. - A no-package read refuses with `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`/409/`ambiguous-in-environment` naming both. - `list`, `listNames` and `exists` see both. - `unregisterPackage` keeps the other package's slot, and `unregister` drops every slot. - CONTROLs: a single holder answers the same object; a package-less write replaces the holder's item (D4); a package write replaces the environment item; an environment item answers any read. A non-slotted type (`flow`) keeps last-write. - **`packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`**: a new `it.each` over every `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` member (the card asks for each type). The metadata service double always answers beta's body, and `?package=A` and `?package=B` must each serve the holder's own label and `_packageId`. - **Forced test change**: `package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts` pins the read set, and the pin now expects E8's nine types plus `api`. - **Dogfood**: new `it`s in `bare-name-one-holder-request-family.dogfood.test.ts` (same boot): - The qualified and `?package` reads give each package its own body and stamp, and the bare read is 409 naming both. - Both `/apps/{alpha,beta}/feed` paths answer from their own declarations. - CONTROL: showcase's single-holder `showcase_task_feed` answers 200 bare, qualified and by `?package`. - Narrowing: the same api at `?package=` of a non-holder, `/meta/api/alpha/…` and `/meta/api/_env/…` answers 409 naming showcase. ## Acceptance notes - `unregister` and `unregisterPackage` still remove a loader-persisted row by name, as before. With two holders, that could reach a same-named row of the other package. This was not introduced here and is not fixed here. It is noted for the seat. - Relay `pr_create` opens this PR as a draft and drops assignees. ## Verification Head 4557015b, branched from main ff04ad81 (main has moved two commits since; no rebase). Every heavy run went under `os-verify-lock`. - `@objectstack/metadata`: 71 files, 996 passed. `@objectstack/objectql`: 583 files, 12031 passed. Both typechecks exit 0. eslint (`--no-inline-config`) on `packages/metadata`, `packages/objectql` and `packages/qa/dogfood`: exit 0. - Dogfood, the full battery: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` at head, 446 files passed (3 skipped), 3699 tests passed (42 skipped), exit 0 (32m38s under the lock). - Gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 69 families on 4557015b. All 69 ran with exit 0, and `--ran` reports 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Two first exited 3 on a missing prerequisite and were rerun green: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed `git fetch origin 621a4876…`, and `check:type-check-debt` had queued behind the dogfood hold, so it was rerun under the lock. - Head readings, from the same probe as base: every CONTROL line is byte-identical to base (md5 checked). Only the rows above changed.
Ablations (each restored, blob equal to HEAD, dist rebuilt, preflight --absent clean) Both used `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. 1. **Store slots off** (`PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` empty). Metadata unit: 4 of 32 red (both endpoints served; read by package; no-package refusal; enumerate/unregister). Dogfood: 1 of 8 red, because `/api/v1/apps/alpha/feed` answered nothing. 2. **`api` out of the read set**. objectql unit: 1 of 24 red (the `api` case of the exact-qualifier `it.each`). Dogfood: 2 of 8 red (the bare read is no longer 409, and the narrowing pin is served). The qualified-body pin stays green, so the store fix alone already gives each package its own body. The read set adds the D3/D5 refusals.

Not applicable (`packages/spec` untouched). - [x] 7. No hand edits to generated docs or changelogs. - [x] 8.
